values.note: Group shelter with its 7 campsites $106 a night.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250002 ('Riverside Campground has 27 campsites', 'Each campsite has a paved camping pad', 'Riverside Group Campsites include ... 7 campsites') + recreation.gov catalog (max vehicle length 40 ft x21, 35 ft x6), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Vault toilets, potable water, dumpsters and hosts during the peak summer months.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250002 ('During the peak summer months services include vault toilets, potable water, dumpsters and campground hosts'; amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. recreation.gov allows booking up to the day of arrival (cutoff 0 days). No-show reservations are cancelled after the third night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250002 (rules: reservationWindow 6 Months, reservationCutOff 0 day(s) prior to arrival, maxStay 14 days rolling 30 days; catalog: all 28 sites reservable; notice 'No show reservations are subject to cancellation after the third night') + https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/canyonferry/ (hosts maintain 'the reservation system via Recreation.gov'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bureau of Reclamation campground on the Missouri River just below Canyon Ferry Dam (head of Hauser Reservoir), ~30 mi E of Helena. Group area with a 30 x 45 ft picnic shelter set apart from the main loop; boat ramp, accessible fishing dock, day-use picnic sites. --Claude
summary: Reclamation's Canyon Ferry page + news release + recreation.gov (Reclamation-run, reservable): recorded a temporary closure from 2026-09-13 through spring 2027 (sidewalk construction); confirmed $15, no electric, 27 sites, vault toilets, potable water, reservable; added recreation.gov platform, 6-month window, 14-night limit, 40-ft max. Not stated: season (rate season May 1 - Sep 13 is not a campground season). Phone 406-475-3920 matches. Note trimmed of restated values.
